title: Requirements Engineering Workbench Specification
description: Baseline requirements for a local, API-first Requirements Engineering Workbench aligned with IREB CPRE terminology.

functional_requirements.title: Manage requirements
functional_requirements.shall: create, read, update and list requirements

functional_requirements.title: Manage user stories
functional_requirements.shall: create, read, update and list user stories

functional_requirements.title: Manage use cases
functional_requirements.shall: create, read, update and list use cases

functional_requirements.title: Manage actors
functional_requirements.shall: create, read, update and list actors

functional_requirements.title: Manage traceability
functional_requirements.shall: create, read, update and list trace links

functional_requirements.title: Generate identifiers
functional_requirements.shall: automatically generate entity-specific identifiers for new entities

functional_requirements.title: Persist data
functional_requirements.shall: persist all managed entities in SQLite

functional_requirements.title: Validate data
functional_requirements.shall: validate entity data using the domain models

functional_requirements.title: Reject duplicate IDs
functional_requirements.shall: reject duplicate identifiers with a conflict response

functional_requirements.title: Filter data
functional_requirements.shall: allow filtering of the currently selected model

functional_requirements.title: Select model
functional_requirements.shall: provide a model select box for Requirements, User Stories, Use Cases, Actors and Traceability

functional_requirements.title: Create and modify
functional_requirements.shall: provide New and Modify actions for model elements

functional_requirements.title: Tooltip modes
functional_requirements.shall: provide Short + IREB, API call and Full + dependencies tooltip modes

functional_requirements.title: Field help
functional_requirements.shall: provide contextual field help and relevant IREB links where available

functional_requirements.title: Expose schema
functional_requirements.shall: expose model and field metadata through an API schema endpoint

api_requirements.shall: provide collection GET/POST and item GET/PUT endpoints for each managed model
return HTTP 404 when an item does not exist
prevent changing an entity ID during update

gui_requirements.shall: serve the workbench at /gui and redirect / to /gui
display the application title, Model selector and Tooltip type selector in the first header line
not display a left-side model navigation pane
switch the displayed model when the Model selector changes
display model elements in a table
provide filtering, New and Modify controls
show validation feedback for invalid input
show action tooltips according to the selected Tooltip type

non_functional_requirements.shall: provide direct access to model selection, filtering, creation and modification
run locally without an external database server
represent relationships through explicit references and trace links

traceability.principle: Every implemented feature should be traceable to one or more requirements.

verification.acceptance: A requirement is accepted when its specified behavior is implemented and covered by an appropriate verification test.
